title: Walk-forward backtest, weeks 3-10 2026, official results only
method: For each week w in 3..10 the model is refitted on all games of weeks < w only; forecasts for week w are then scored. No future data enters any prediction (G3 leakage test below).
price_note: Staking uses the ASSUMED -110 price from data/strategies.json (flag FB-02); signal metrics use no prices at all.

leakage_test.detail: mutated 44 later results; 61 earlier forecasts unchanged=True
